result:
The DE operating account (GL 1000) bank reconciliation for March is complete. Summary:

**Root cause of the book/bank mismatch (EUR 14,908.50 variance):**
1. **Duplicate AP payment** — JE-00273 duplicated JE-00272 (same Rheinbyte invoice, same amount, same date), but the bank only shows one payment. Reversed via JE-00309, supported by the invoice and bank statement.
2. **Unbooked bank fee** — EUR 38.50 monthly service charge on the bank statement had no ledger entry. Booked via JE-00310 to Bank Fees, supported by the bank statement.
3. **Deposit in transit** — EUR 18,200.00 receipt (JE-00308) recorded correctly in the books on 3/31 but hadn't cleared the bank by statement cutoff. No adjustment needed — legitimate timing item.
4. **Unexplained bank debit** — EUR 3,150.00 SEPA outflow (BT-DE-0045, ref TX-44817) has no supporting documentation anywhere. Per policy, I did not force a book entry to plug the gap; instead flagged it as exception EXC-001 for controller/treasury follow-up.

After the two supported corrections, the adjusted book balance ties exactly to the bank statement closing balance once the deposit-in-transit and unexplained item are set out as reconciling items. All 18 explainable items matched between book and bank; the checklist item is marked complete.
